title: Ento-Linguistics: Language, Ambiguity, and Scientific Communication in Entomology
description: Descriptive Ento-Linguistic corpus analyses with a six-domain framework, a fixed-margin terminology-network comparison, and a 20-minute research lecture. Version 1.2.0 adds 600 primary and 300 protocol-sensitivity draws, full traces and independent provenance. The comparison is conditional on the selected vocabulary and convenience corpus; it does not measure causal language effects or author intent. Paper and media: CC BY 4.0; source corpus materials remain subject to their providers' terms. Version 1.2.1 validates decoded retained traces, reconstructs observed statistics and checks report consistency; the statistical model and lecture media are unchanged.
